name: @sauce/random
description: SauceScript's verifiable randomness, delivered to a `.then`: `Random.vrf({ words })` requests Chainlink VRF v2.5 random words, paid in the native coin through the chain's VRFV2PlusWrapper, and `Random.entropy()` a Pyth Entropy v2 random number; the body runs on the same Private Pot when the provider calls back. The handlers answer `rawFulfillRandomWords` and `_entropyCallback`. Built on `@sauce/async`. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (random.evm.js); there is no SVM arm, because the handlers a callback lands on are a Private Pot's Router's.
